system.description:
While other clans prattle about the wars of the Antediluvians, the Baali have remained dedicated to a dark purpose: the release of their lords and masters onto an unsuspecting earth. Open the Way is the method by which this unholy act might be enacted, and such is the might and depravity required to use this power that it has only been attempted thrice in all of history — and all three attempts have failed. The intense formality of Open the Way's use has become psychologically impossible to exercise without an extensive ritual to "prepare" the Opener, though in truth the power would function without the trappings if performed by a Baali who did not believe in them; no such Baali currently exist.

System: The preparatory ritual requires a tremendous investment of time and sacrifice. The caster must chant paeans to the entity he is attempting to awaken, uninterrupted, for 48 consecutive hours; the slightest stammer or interruption causes the rite to fail and may attract the unwelcome attention of the entity being petitioned. At the conclusion of the chanting, the Baali must sacrifice a hundred free, untainted souls (mortal or Cainite, each with a Conscience rating of at least four). The Baali then summons and releases all of his Willpower, expending nine points of permanent Willpower in an attempt to shatter the bonds holding his master outside the world. If a Willpower roll (difficulty 10) succeeds, the Baali becomes an empty vessel and the gate through which his master flows back into reality — from that point on the character is no longer playable, having become an aspect of his foul master.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
system.prerequisites: 48 consecutive hours of uninterrupted ritual chanting; sacrifice of 100 free, untainted souls of Conscience 4+; expenditure of 9 permanent Willpower points
